home.title: Outlap — Formula 1 seasons, races, drivers and stories
home.description: An unofficial Formula 1 fan site: seasons, races, drivers, teams, circuits and stories.

sections.seasons: Every Formula 1 season since 1950: champions, standings and races.

sections.teams: Every Formula 1 team since 1950: history, titles, wins and drivers.
sections.circuits: Formula 1 circuits: layout, length, corners and winners.
sections.stories: Long reads on the races and rules that shaped Formula 1, with every claim sourced.
sections.newbie: New to Formula 1? The rules, terms and race weekend explained.

gamePage.metaDescription: Hot lap — the Outlap mini-game: one lap of a made-up circuit against a bot and your own ghost. Four circuits, a record on each.
gamePage.title: Hot lap
gamePage.lead: One lap of a made-up circuit, roughly 25 to 45 seconds. Four circuits with their own character. Your best lap drives next to you as a ghost.

how.b: Wait for the five red lights to go out, then throttle. Any earlier is a jump start, +1 s.
how.c: Beat the bot, then beat yourself. Off-track with all four wheels costs +1 s.

lyman.name: Lyman
lyman.desc: Outlap's first circuit. A long straight, long arcs and grass past the kerbs, so a mistake can still be saved.

port.name: Harbour
port.desc: Straights between city blocks and right-angle corners. The wall is a few metres past the white line, so there is no running wide.

plateau.name: Plateau
plateau.desc: The longest and widest. Two long straights, fast arcs and one big stop before the hairpin. Sand slows you more than grass.

forest.name: Pinewood
forest.desc: The shortest and narrowest: esses, a hairpin and pine trees right behind the barriers. Braking wins it here.

gamePage.gameLabel: Hot lap game: arrow keys or WASD, Space to start
gamePage.noscript: The game needs JavaScript turned on.
gamePage.readyP: When the five red lights go out, hit the throttle. Throttle before that is a jump start, +1 s. Leaving the track with all four wheels also costs +1 s.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to Outlap with a code sent to your email.
login.lead: Enter your email and we will send an 8-digit code. No password to remember.
login.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.codeHint: Digits only. Check Spam if it does not arrive within a minute.
login.resendWait: Send a new code in {s} s
login.resent: A new code has been sent.
login.privacy: We use your email only to send the code and recognise you. It is never shown to other players.

errors.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
errors.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it or request a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

nick.lead: Other players will see it in the standings. Your email stays private.
nick.label: Nickname
nick.hint: 3–24 characters: Latin or Cyrillic letters, digits, spaces and . _ - — no emoji or accents. You can change it later.

errors.chars: Use only Latin or Cyrillic letters, digits, . _ - and single spaces; start and end with a letter or digit.
errors.reserved: This name is reserved. Choose another one.
errors.taken: This nickname is taken or looks too much like another one.
errors.blocked: This account cannot change the nickname.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.unavailable: Could not save right now. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little.
errors.mixed: Use letters from one alphabet only: Latin or Cyrillic, not both. Digits are fine with either.
